_README: Copy this file to config/credentials.local.json (gitignored) OR use the dashboard CONNECTION tab, which writes it for you (chmod 600). api_url is optional and defaults to the OANDA host for the type; only OANDA's v20 REST API is supported (see docs/DASHBOARD.md 'Broker compatibility'). Get keys at https://www.oanda.com/ (Manage API Access). NEVER commit real values.
